name: demo-platform
description: Independent demonstration application for Cloudflare Pages + D1 + R2

scripts.dev: wrangler pages dev public --d1 DB=local --r2 R2=local
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute demo-platform-db --local --file=migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute demo-platform-db --local --file=migrations/0003_admin_sessions.sql
scripts.db:remote:migrate: wrangler d1 execute demo-platform-db --file=migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute demo-platform-db --file=migrations/0003_admin_sessions.sql
